newsitem.title: USA: Fifth Third gets approvals to buy Suburban.
newsitem.headline: Fifth Third gets approvals to buy Suburban.

text.p: Fifth Third Bancorp said Tuesday it has received the necessary shareholder and regulatory approvals to complete its $31.8 million purchase of Suburban Bancorp Inc.
Surburban Bancorp has seven offices, $221.9 million in assets, $133.3 million in deposits and $25.9 million in equity.
The transaction is expected to be completed on July 25.
Each outstanding share of Suburban stock will be converted into 0.36536 of a share of Fifth Third common stock adjusted for Fifth Third's recently announced stock split in a tax-free exchange.
